title: Structural requirements for the specific binding of CRABP2 to cyclin D3.
authors: Pastok, Martyna W; Tomlinson, Charles W E; Turberville, Shannon; Butler, Abbey M; Basle, Arnaud; Noble, Martin E M; Endicott, Jane A; Pohl, Ehmke; Tatum, Natalie J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CRABP2与cyclin D3的蛋白-蛋白结合结构要求，虽非TF-DNA体系，但涉及结合位点与AlphaFold复合物建模，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Cellular retinoic acid binding protein 2 (CRABP2) transports retinoic acid from the cytoplasm to the nucleus where it then transfers its cargo to retinoic acid receptor-containing complexes leading to activation of gene transcription. We demonstrate using purified proteins that CRABP2 is also a cyclin D3-specific binding protein and that the CRABP2 cyclin D3 binding site and the proposed CRABP2 nuclear localization sequence overlap. Both sequences are within the helix-loop-helix motif that forms a lid to the retinoic acid binding pocket. Mutations within this sequence that block both cyclin D3 and retinoic acid binding promote formation of a CRABP2 structure in which the retinoic acid binding pocket is occupied by an alternative lid conformation. Structural and functional analysis of CRABP2 and cyclin D3 mutants combined with AlphaFold models of the ternary CDK4/6-cyclin D3-CRABP2 complex supports the identification of an alpha-helical protein binding site on the cyclin D3 C-terminal cyclin box fold.
abstract_zh: 细胞维甲酸结合蛋白2（CRABP2）将维甲酸从细胞质转运至细胞核，在那里将其货物转移至含维甲酸受体的复合物，从而激活基因转录。我们利用纯化蛋白证明，CRABP2也是一种细胞周期蛋白D3特异性结合蛋白，且CRABP2的细胞周期蛋白D3结合位点与推测的CRABP2核定位序列重叠。这两个序列均位于螺旋-环-螺旋基序内，该基序形成维甲酸结合口袋的盖子。该序列内的突变同时阻断细胞周期蛋白D3和维甲酸结合，促进形成一种CRABP2结构，其中维甲酸结合口袋被替代性盖子构象占据。对CRABP2和细胞周期蛋白D3突变体的结构与功能分析，结合三元CDK4/6-细胞周期蛋白D3-CRABP2复合物的AlphaFold模型，支持在细胞周期蛋白D3 C末端细胞周期蛋白盒折叠上识别出一个α-螺旋蛋白结合位点。
